europe_now.title: French Student Demonstrations and Government Suspension of Stun Grenades
europe_now.summary: France has suspended the use of stun grenades during ongoing student protests after a pupil lost a hand. Meanwhile, authorities reported thousands of arrests since the demonstrations began, prompting the government to address security and public anger.

europe_now.title: Deadly Russian Missile Attack in Ukraine
europe_now.summary: A Russian missile strike hit a residential block of flats, resulting in nineteen deaths including children who were killed while they slept. The incident highlights the ongoing escalation of conflict and civilian casualties in Eastern Europe.

top_stories.title: French Protests and Government Response
top_stories.summary: French students and high schoolers called for fresh protests amid growing education funding demands. The French prime minister vowed to address national debt and defuse public anger during a sweeping policy address.

europe_now.title: France Restricts Crowd Control Gear Amid Unrest
europe_now.summary: Authorities in France have suspended the use of stun grenades at student demonstrations following an incident where a participant suffered severe injury. Meanwhile, government officials continue to face nationwide protests and growing political tension regarding economic policy and security measures.

europe_now.title: Russian Missile Attack Hits Residential Block
europe_now.summary: A lethal Russian missile strike has impacted a residential apartment building in Ukraine, resulting in numerous fatalities including children who were asleep at the time. The incident underscores the ongoing severe security crisis and civilian toll in the region.

top_stories.title: French Student Demonstrations and Official Reaction
top_stories.summary: High school and university students across France have staged continuous demonstrations to demand increased education funding and address national debt issues. The government responded by suspending specific crowd control munitions after a protester was severely injured during the ongoing unrest.

europe_now.summary: France faces escalating high school and university protests over education funding and debt policies, resulting in thousands of arrests and the suspension of stun grenade usage after a protester lost a hand.

europe_now.title: Death of Spanish Housing Crisis Symbol
europe_now.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, an 87-year-old pensioner whose eviction became a major symbol and catalyst for nationwide housing protests in Spain, has passed away according to tenant unions.

top_stories.title: French Demonstrations and Government Response
top_stories.summary: French students continue nationwide demonstrations demanding increased educational funding and measures addressing national debt. In response to severe injuries during the demonstrations, the government suspended the use of specific crowd control munitions.

top_stories.title: Spanish Housing Rights Movement Mourns Key Figure
top_stories.summary: Tenant unions and housing organizations in Spain confirmed the death of Maricarmen Abascal at the age of 87. Her previous eviction sparked widespread public outrage and catalyzed nationwide protests over affordable housing.
